## Erosion-CN v1.0.3 (Build 28)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **System Compatibility / 系统兼容性提示**  
> - **Supported / 完整支持**: `iOS / iPadOS 27.0 – 27.2.1` and `27.3 beta 1` (`24C503*`).  
> - **Patched / 已封堵**: Apple patched `worse_query` starting in **`iOS 27.3 beta 2` (`24C5049d+`)**. Do **NOT** update past `27.3 beta 1` if you rely on Erosion-CN.

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **Anti-Recreate Sentinel Lock (`0555` + `0444` `.erosion_adlock`) / 防重建占位锁加固**
   - Locking an ad directory now wipes existing ad files, places a 0-byte `0444` read-only sentinel file (`.erosion_adlock`) inside, and sets `0555` on the directory so ad SDKs cannot remove an empty `0555` folder and recreate a fresh `0755` folder under writable parent directories.
   - Unlocking (`0755`) removes `.erosion_adlock` automatically, and legacy weak `0555` locks show a one-tap **Harden** (`加固防重建`) action.

2. **`AppGroup` Shared Container Scan & Standalone Ad Config File Lock + Preview / 共享组扫描与单文件配置锁死预览**
   - Extends scanning to `/var/mobile/Containers/Shared/AppGroup` (automatically skipping system & proxy client groups).
   - Recognizes standalone splash/ad config files (`splash_ad.json`, `splash_ad.plist`, `launch_ad.*`, etc.) with inline **Preview** (`PlistViewer` / `TextViewer`) and safe in-place empty JSON/Plist overwrite + `0444` locking.

3. **Custom Watch List (`+` & File Browser Long-Press) / 自定义广告路径收藏**
   - Add custom ad folders or config files via the top-right **`+`** button or by long-pressing any eligible item in File Browser → **Add to Ad Blocker** (`加入广告锁死列表`), strictly enforcing safety guards against system directories, container roots, `Downloads`, symlinks, and core app preference plists.

4. **Boundary & Network Pairing Guidance / 生效边界与搭配建议**
   - Added a dedicated notice card inside `Splash Ad Blocker` reminding users that local directory/config locking stops disk caching while live ad network requests still fire — pairing with proxy ad-blocking rules (Surge / Quantumult X / Loon / Stash / Shadowrocket, etc.) gives complete coverage.

> 📜 Full changelog / 完整更新日志：**[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)** · User Guide / 使用指南：**[USAGE_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/USAGE_GUIDE.md)**
